title: Module sections under extension of a separably closed field
statement: Let k,K be fields with k separably closed, Λ a commutative ring, S a k-scheme, t : Spec K → Spec k, and (i,p′,p,t) Cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. For every etale sheaf F of Λ-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on S, restriction Γ(S,F) → Γ(S′,i*F) is injective. No integrality of p or algebraic closedness of K is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A3I; canonical module/set comparison; proof generalized from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.AlgClosedExtensionModuleSections

proof.text: Use the k-algebra structure on K defined by Spec.preimage t. Apply etale_sections_base_field_extension to the underlying set sheaf. Compose its bijective unit with isIso_upperStar_forget_comparison; the homEquiv unit formula identifies the resulting function with the module unit.

Use naturality with the terminal-object isomorphism to move from identity-object evaluation to global sections. This makes the canonical pullback section map an isomorphism. Use the isomorphism from the given Cartesian square to the canonical pullback and globalSectionsUpperStarMap_comp′ to transport it to i, then use ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleModuleSectionsFieldExtension_injective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [IsSepClosed k]
    {S S' : Scheme.{u}} (p : S ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (t : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (i : S' ⟶ S) (p' : S' ⟶ Spec (.of K)) (sq : IsPullback i p' p t)
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Function.Injective (globalSectionsUpperStarMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i F).hom
